verdict.first_step_1: Inspect the starter for visible signs of death (fuzzy mold or pink/orange streaks) and check the flour packaging for malted barley flour before running a split-jar test.
verdict.first_step_2: Run an immediate two-jar comparison test using marked jars to record peak rise times between the new flour and a reference flour before changing anything else.
verdict.reason: Reply 2 provides an immediate, clear first step using marked jars and explains that timing does not prove causation, whereas Reply 1 buries its guidance, omits the timing-versus-cause explanation, and explicitly contradicts the facts by dismissing the float test.
